summary: America's Car-Mart filed an 8-K disclosing a further extension, to October 8, 2026, of the scheduled termination date and temporary waivers of minimum liquidity and Collateral Coverage Ratio covenants under its October 30, 2025 Credit and Guaranty Agreement with Silver Point Finance as agent. The company remains in a strategic-alternatives evaluation overseen by a special committee, contemplating financing, recapitalization, restructuring, M&A or other transactions, with active third-party, agent and lender discussions. Repeated near-term extensions and anticipated defaults frame the risk-arb question: whether a transaction lands before the next deadline.
